verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP documents realtime destinations that forward incoming events to dozens of pre-configured tools. This includes CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot and SaaS tools like Braze and Customer.io. A generic webhook destination can send events to any HTTP endpoint, with filtering, testing, logs and editable Hog code. Batch exports add scheduled delivery. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that destinations work in practice, and explicit evidence naming ad-platform destinations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream events onward to third-party destinations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks) from the analytics platform

citations.quote: PostHog enables you to send realtime data to dozens of pre-configured destinations
